orchid.name: Orchid's Gentle Advance
orchid.line: We seek peace early, then secure the middle ford while rivals clash.

rhino.name: Rhino Vanguard Strikes
rhino.line: We strike first! Horse across West Ford, raid Orchid camp for its standard.

tiger.name: Tiger General's Watch
tiger.line: Patience, Tiger. Deceive and mass on the East Ford. Hold the line.

kite.name: KITE GENERAL
kite.line: Trust nothing old. Hold the east ford with elephants and foot; archers on the north bank shoot every rider.

orchid.thought: My doctrine is to seek peace early via letter. Since I have no immediate threats, I will send a ciphered letter to all houses proposing a truce. I will keep my forces near my camp for now.

tiger.thought: First watch. Doctrine dictates decoy west ford. No immediate threats, so mass east ford late. Sending scout to F1 to see initial enemy positions, as per general scouting wisdom.

kite.thought: My doctrine demands holding the east ford (F3) with elephants and foot, and archers on the north bank. I must reinforce these positions immediately. Sending orders to establish this posture.

rhino.thought: Doctrine dictates immediate horse raid on Orchid camp. Rhino cav-1 goes to attack Orchid Camp standard. Rhino inf/arch support the main thrust, or screen/move to F1/F2/F3.

Doctrine dictates a swift raid on Orchid camp for its standard using cavalry. I will order rhino-cav-1 to attack ORCHID CAMP immediately, as per doctrine. The infantry and archers will hold RHINO CAMP to secure the rear.

orchid.thought: Doctrine suggests seeking peace via letter, then taking the middle ford. With no intelligence, I will start by sending a ciphered letter to initiate diplomacy, while positioning forces to secure F2 later.
